data.name: Prophetic Visionary (Mythic)
data.description: Your precognitive powers aid you further. You can use Prophetic Visionary's augury ability at will, spending 10 minutes in a deep trance each time. Your chance of a successful augury increases by . A successful augury made by using this feat also grants you the benefits of guidance, but the bonus is and is an insight bonus instead of a competence bonus.
